title: Hermes coordinator boot configuration
description: Boot defaults for the Hermes coordinator (proposal.md §2). Secrets live in .env, runtime state lives in the SQLite database — never here.

drive_root.description: Drive backup + inbox root (v7: carries input/, processed/, knowledge_base/ — the daily backup of the Pi-local docs/ record; §12).

timezone.description: IANA-looking Area/City anchor for human-facing times; probed with zoneinfo when the config is loaded.

group_id.description: Team group chat id; empty = no group broadcasts.

default_model.description: Model id; setup.sh writes it into Hermes twice (global default + cron.model pin). No budget knob: the cap is the OpenRouter per-key limit.

freshness_ttl_minutes.description: Read-through gate on knowledge_search: after this many minutes the next search refreshes the cache via the deterministic sync (default 10).
